name: EULA ~2026 Inryu Changjak Bogoseo~
source:
A visual novel that asks whether Al-generated art is really yours.

Your wrist is shot, your posts get hate instead of likes, nothing you draw
feels right ...
Then a friend recommends HumbleAl to you.
"Maybe just use it as a helper tool?"

The terms of service appear on screen.
[Agree] - your cursor hovers over the button.

To not fall behind: [Agree]
To not give in: [Refuse]

Organic: Hand-drawn by the creator.
Al: Generated in a single click.
One story splits into two worlds.

[From [url=https://www.moeater.com/eula?lang=en]official website[/url]]
